answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 5592 Country: India Title: I wanna know deleting of sound and written matter of holy Quran from computer , mobile ,mp4 etc is jaiz or najaiz. I think it is equal to destroy of holy Quran. Question: I wanna know deleting of sound and written matter of holy Quran from computer , mobile ,mp4 etc is jaiz or najaiz. I think it is equal to destroy of holy Quran. Answer ID: 5592 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 179/179=M) If the purpose of deleting audio files and word of the Holy Quran is replacing them with songs, pictures or saving wrong matters then it is impressible. And if the deletion is meant to protect the Quran from desecration then it is not only permissible but commendable, as a rule of Fiqh says: الا مور بمقاصدها After all, in both the ways, it will not be called destroying the Holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
